sources.equip-suit-source-v1.png: Initial eight-pose dressing and zipper sheet; preserved unchanged.
sources.equip-suit-alpha-v2.png: Selected dressing candidate. Composite over solid blue-gray confirms transparent empty space. Brown preview haze is RGB beneath alpha, not an opaque backdrop.
sources.gloves-helmet-source-v1.png: Selected glove and helmet candidate. Full-face helmet closes over ears; no fur remains in final equipped pose. Gloves sequence does not show boot fastening.

packingReview.scope: Four southeast strips, four frames each, review staging only; no runtime changes.
packingReview.checks: Source dimensions, transparent alpha, unclipped source boundaries, destination margins and provenance hashes pass for 16 frames.
packingReview.cropCorrections: Helmet sheet row boundary is y=495 to preserve lifted helmet. Lower first/second cells split at x=392 to retain held helmet with its owner and exclude a neighboring sliver.
packingReview.scale: One uniform 0.45 source scale. Contact baseline is independent of ear/helmet height; no per-frame silhouette stretching.

visualFindings: Suit-on progression reads as holding garment, stepping in, pulling trousers up, then pulling sleeves onto shoulders.
Zip-up progression visibly closes the front from waist to throat, with no exposed body.
Glove and helmet actions are distinct; final closed helmet and broad boots match the intended shared riding appearance.

Source figures shift horizontally between poses. Suit-on frames one and two use manually inspected planted-shoe centers because the held suit reaches lower than the rabbit's shoes; all other frames use the lowest 16-pixel alpha band. Each planted contact registers to (128, 238).

The native LÖVE review shows Ginger fur with Blue overalls and Silver fur with Gold overalls across all sixteen frames. Brown leather and the olive helmet stay unchanged; the final two helmet frames have no exposed-fur or overalls masks.

Action strips normalize to 214–219 visible source pixels for comparison with normal idle. The raw geared idle is 198 pixels, about 77% of the 256-pixel reference; shoulder, hip and boot fit is presented in the native review.

Native single-pose review: output/commute-gear-actions-review/native-review.png. Full native 16-frame colorway grid: output/commute-gear-actions-review/native-colorway-grid.png. Pixel checks: output/commute-gear-actions-review/native-colorway-grid-checks.txt.
remaining: Other camera-relative facings or a deliberate turn-to-dress presentation
